mentions.name: MacroCodex
mentions.description: This app provides sensorless adaptive TDEE (total daily calorie burn) tracking that requires no watch or wearable, aiming for guaranteed weight loss within 2–3 weeks, with results often visible in the first week. It is completely free with no subscription or ads, includes a 2,000+ member community, and works on Android, iOS, and any platform where a PWA can run.
mentions.problem: Wearable-based TDEE tracking requires a device and is less accurate than the sensorless adaptive technique used here.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Guaranteed results are achieved using the state of the art adaptive TDEE (total calorie burn of the day) tracking technique we've developed. It's sensorless, so no watch or other wearable is needed. It's way more accurate than those wearables (data included on the website), and our group has 2,000+ members ( https://macrocodex.app/community/ ). You can also read Play Store reviews.

All this completely free, no subscription or ads: 
https://macrocodex.app/

MacroCodex also works on both Android and iOS and any platform where PWA app can run.

Has 16k users and includes a knowledge section explaining the method.

mentions.name: MacroCodex
mentions.description: This app estimates your true maintenance calories (TDEE) with an algorithm that is more accurate than traditional regression-based formulas (e.g. Katch-McArdle) or calorie burn tracking from fitness bands and watches. It spots dips in maintenance calories caused by metabolic adaptation, then automatically adjusts your calorie target and macros so your plan stays aligned with your real maintenance calories. It is completely free with no paywall or unnecessary data collection, and has reached 13,000+ users.
mentions.problem: Traditional regression-based formulas and fitness trackers are inaccurate at determining maintenance calories, and metabolic adaptation causes dips in maintenance calories, making it hard for some people to gain or lose weight.
mentions.audience: Those who find it hard to gain or lose weight.
mentions.source_excerpt: MacroCodex helps you spot dips in maintenance calories from metabolic adaptation, then auto adjusts your calorie target and macros so your plan stays aligned with your real maintenance calories (TDEE).

mentions.name: MacroCodex
mentions.description: MacroCodex is an adaptive TDEE tracker that refines the static estimates from standard TDEE calculators into an adaptive TDEE that continuously updates based on the user's activity level and calorie intake. It indicates when to lean bulk, cut, or recomp, and automatically provides recommended macro and calorie targets that change as the adaptive TDEE changes. The site also hosts multiple guides and tools, including a recomposition guide.
mentions.problem: Most TDEE calculators only provide estimates that don't adapt to changing activity level and calorie intake.
mentions.source_excerpt:
MacroCodex - Adaptive TDEE tracker

Most TDEE calculators only provide estimates. MacroCodex helps you refine those estimates to calculate a more accurate TDEE, which continuously changes based on your activity level and calorie intake.
